reason: CmdPlantTree's argument struct OpenTTDPlantTreeArgs (tile, start_tile, tree_to_plant, diagonal): docs/porting.md#argument-structs requires a ported command to take one argument struct defined once in Rust with a generated declaration, which the C++ facade passes as const Args *. It replaces the hand-written OpenTTDTreeCommandSettings, OpenTTDTreeCommandResult, OpenTTDTreeCommand and the three observation records deleted from trees_ffi.h and tree_cmd.cpp in the same change.
existing_alternatives: No command argument struct for CmdPlantTree exists; the positional export it replaces is what the argument-struct rule retires.
retirement_condition: Retires when the command dispatcher calls cmd_plant_tree from Rust and no C++ facade passes the struct.

reason: The native map read test compared the tree_map.rs readers with the tree_observation service, which this pass deletes. Plan decision 8 of #954 moves that oracle into MapLeafOracle, which ObserveMapLeaves fills from the native GetTreeGround, GetTreeDensity, GetTreeType, GetTreeCount and GetTreeGrowth: one field line, the tree_map.h include and a three-line block. The test observes live native accessors, so it stays C++ (ADR 0023).
existing_alternatives: Rust tests cannot call the native accessors, and the deleted service was the only other oracle.
retirement_condition: Retires with the native map read test when the tree_map.h accessors are ported and the native ones are deleted.
